title: Inbox triage
description: Sorts a shared inbox by priority and topic, summarises each email and drafts a reply for review.

spec.input: Emails from a shared or personal inbox
spec.output: Priority, topic, summary and draft reply per email

problem: Client services staff open the inbox each morning and read every email to decide what is urgent. Complaints, billing disputes and suspicious emails sit next to newsletters, so important messages can wait days for a reply. Each reply is written from scratch.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: New emails arrive in the Outlook inbox and are collected in a batch.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude reads each email, sets priority and topic, writes a short summary and drafts a reply.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Suspected phishing, complaints and anything needing a partner are flagged. Drafts use placeholders where a person must confirm details.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: Categories and flags land in Outlook and drafts are saved for review. Nothing is sent automatically.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Reads each email, sets priority and topic, writes the summary and draft reply.

stack.name: Outlook
stack.role: Inbox source. Draft replies are saved here and never sent automatically.

stack.name: Power Automate
stack.role: Applies categories and flags to each email in Outlook.

stack.name: Microsoft 365
stack.role: Accounts, mailbox permissions and security for the whole flow.
